ABOUT THE COMPANY
Mayfly Ventures Pty Ltd is a venture studio founded in 2022 and based in Melbourne, Victoria, specialising in building vertical SaaS and AI ventures. The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Analyse user requirements and translate them into software specifications, user flows, information architecture, and technical design decisions
• Architect scalable, performant application structures including database design, backend workflow logic, and API integration strategies
• Design and develop responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces applying UI/UX design principles to maximise usability, engagement, and product quality
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and external services to extend
application functionality

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as a Developer Programmer, Software Developer, or equivalent, with a strong portfolio of delivered software projects
• Proficiency in no-code application development, particularly Bubble.io, with demonstrated ability to build complex, production-grade web and mobile applications
• Solid understanding of database design, data modelling, relational structures, and backend workflow logic
• Demonstrated experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services into production application environments
• Strong UI/UX design capability including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design using tools such as Figma
• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for front-end customisation and interface optimisation
• Experience applying Agile methodologies and using project management tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or Trello
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and system-level thinking
• Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities, with capacity to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced delivery environment

DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES
• Experience designing and deploying AI-integrated product features and agentic or automated decision workflows
• Familiarity with additional platforms and tools such as Cursor, Bubble, Xano, and AI
• Experience with payment infrastructure integration (e.g. Stripe Connect) and end-to-end monetisation flow design
• Experience leading small development or design teams across concurrent client-facing delivery engagements
• Experience working across multiple industries including fintech, health, education, logistics, or hospitality technology sectors

HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates should submit a current resume, a cover letter addressing the key
selection criteria, and examples of relevant projects or a portfolio link to careers@mayflyventures.com

The Role 

You will have the opportunity to work at an established business which will develop you professionally and to allow you to hone your skills and techniques even further. You will also have opportunities to progress in the business and play an important role in the continued success of the restaurant. 

This is a full time role with an annual salary set at $80,000 plus superannuation.

Costing menu items including costing of food and labour costs 

Plan, collect, estimate food and commodities for menus 

Skills in a wide range of cookery methods to produce a range of menu items 

Plan and sequence the timing of food and preparation of tasks 

Evaluate food products to ensure quality standards are consistently attained 

Being responsible for examining, tasting and improving all food prepared to ensure quality

Work to resolving kitchen related issues, listen to feedbacks and seek solutions in conjunction with fellow staff

Relevant Certificate 3 or 4 qualifications in commercial cookery  

Minimum 12 months of experience as a Chef

Experience in adherence to recipe & portion control, as well as ordering and stock control 

Ability to follow instruction & take direction 

Excellent time management and attention to detail 

Knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards 

Excellent communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team 

Be available to work on weekends to deal with many customers

 Apply now
 Job no: 944552

 Categories: Administration, Business and Management





 

Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network
 

Rural and Remote Mental Health - Parkside 

Salary: ASO5 $92,122 - $102,456 per annum

Full-Time, Temporary up to 8th January 2028 

WHAT ARE WE OFFERING? 

The Administration Manager provides leadership and coordination of administrative services across the Rural and Remote Mental Health Service, and Barossa Hills Fleurieu Community Mental Health Team (CMHTs), ensuring the delivery of efficient, high-quality day-to-day operations including workforce planning, rostering, recruitment and performance management. It plays a key role in fostering a positive, customer-focused team culture while providing strategic HR and operational support across onboarding, staff development, workforce administration and compliance, and driving ongoing improvement in systems, processes and service delivery.

The position contributes to effective governance and strong business operations through committee coordination, reporting and capital processes, working collaboratively with senior leaders, clinicians and stakeholders to support integrated service delivery. It also supports budget monitoring, operational and workforce planning, funding submissions, quality improvement activities and project work, while assisting with high-quality reporting and responses to enquiries and consumer matters.

WHO ARE WE? 

The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Our mission is to ensure that you always receive the best quality, safe, consistent, collaborative care and always with kindness. We do this by maintaining exceptional levels of care at all times supported by systems and processes that assure us of quality and safety of our staff and those we serve.

WHERE AND HOW YOU WILL WORK 

Parkside, South Australia is a well-located inner-southern suburb just minutes from Adelaide's CBD, known for its leafy streets, convenient transport options, and easy access to local caf s, parks, and everyday amenities.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 

How do you build effective working relationships and communicate with a wide range of stakeholders across an organisation?

Are you motivated to lead and inspire a high-performing administrative team in a dynamic healthcare environment? 

Do you take pride in delivering efficient, high-quality services while continuously improving systems and processes?

The Senior Activations Manager ensures all pacing and performance goals are met across all Addressable campaigns and acts as the trading lead across their client patch. Partnership

Product

1. Provide insights to your Client Services and/or Agency Teams to assist with the overall digital strategy of future campaigns. Leading the charge on thought leadership across activations, encouraging innovation and test and learn opportunities to drive strategy.

Profile

Performance

5. Assist in implementing processes to drive efficiencies within your client patch

6. Identify and assist in creation of innovation and test & learn projects.

7. Identify and lead digital growth opportunities for clients via channel diversification

People

3. Provide daily direction to trading team via task management and prioritization in line with agency requests and client SLA’s.
